name: Fineotex Chemical Ltd
title: Fineotex Chemical Ltd - 533333 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 162% to INR314 cr and PAT up 118% to INR44 cr on acquired CrudeChem (CCT); supply-side evidence thin, Ambernath utilisation only 60-62%, and management gave soft targets (US$200m by 2028, 18-20% EBITDA) without hard numbers.

utilisation.quote: overall, we are at 60%, 62% broadly at the moment on the quarter 4 numbers

capex.quote: we are now in process of doubling the manufacturing capacity in CrudeChem

triggers.label: CCT capacity doubling underway
triggers.quote: we are now in process of doubling the manufacturing capacity in CrudeChem

triggers.label: Group utilisation ~61%
triggers.quote: overall, we are at 60%, 62% broadly at the moment on the quarter 4 numbers

triggers.label: Working capital 79-90 days, OCF negative
triggers.quote: even if it's up to 90 days, it's not a big problem for us

triggers.label: Raw material costs passed on
triggers.quote: We keep passing on the increase. And by and large, our team has done a very good job

guidance.quote: Earlier, our expectation to touch $200 million was something in 2030.
On a blended level, we would always look at getting to an easy EBITDA of around 18% to 20%
comfortably, we should be at EBITDA of 15% more or less.
that further 25% has to be sold by them to Finotech's in January '28
